The three data models — configuration vs runtimeManaged-engine model(weakly typed · protocol-agnostic)Internal model(strongly-typed · in-library)Protocol model(protocol-specific · stays in impl.)Configuration(built once atconstruction)Runtime(values, per enginecycle)DataPortCommunicationNodesLinkedNodesTypedNode(s) IDataPoint(s)Protocol structures(nodes · topics · rows, tables …)ExternalValue(channel-keyed)IDatapointValue(s)Protocol values(may not exist)Most of the library maps between these models: engine ↔ internal is the framework boundary, internal ↔ protocol the one each implementation owns.derived fromderived fromderived from
